name: kinetune
description: Make AI music videos, lyric videos and Spotify Canvas loops from your songs with Kinetune: read the shot list, pick a Look, confirm, and get the finished video.

interface.longDescription: Kinetune makes every video a song needs: AI music videos, lyric videos and Spotify Canvas loops. Connect your Kinetune account and ask in plain words. For a music video, an AI director reads the song and writes a shot list you can read and change before anything is made; the artist then sings on camera, lip-synced, from their character. Lyric videos are timed to every word, in reusable Looks, and a Canvas loop is designed from the song's cover, all in 9:16, 16:9 or 1:1. Before anything is made, Kinetune tells you exactly what it will create and waits for your go, then returns download links. You can also upload songs and lyrics, set up the artist's character and kit, and manage your Looks.
capabilities: Make AI music videos that star the artist
Read and change the shot list first
Confirms every video before making it
Upload songs, lyrics and artist photos
defaultPrompt: Make a performance music video for my new single
Make a vertical lyric video for my latest song
Make a Spotify Canvas for my new single

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the organization name and the available credits; nothing is created or charged.

positive.description: Browse Official Looks in one category
positive.prompt: Show me official release Looks on Kinetune.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Official Looks in the release category with their names, descriptions and preview images.

positive.description: Quote a lyric video without creating it
positive.prompt: Find my song Barefoot in the Tide and tell me what a vertical lyric video costs with the Mint Monolith Debut Look.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the analyzed song and the Look, returns the exact credits from the quote, and asks before creating anything.

positive.description: Create the quoted lyric video after agreement
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the video with the same input plus the quote_id from the previous step, waits until it completes, and returns the download link.

positive.description: Quote a Spotify Canvas from a stock video
positive.prompt: Quote a Spotify Canvas for Midnight Coffee using a stock video.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the exact credits for an 8-second Canvas with the stock-video source and waits for agreement before creating it.

positive.description: Plan and quote a music video without making it
positive.prompt: Plan a 30-second performance music video for Barefoot in the Tide and tell me what it costs.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the song and the artist's character, writes the shot list and shows its concept and shots, then returns the exact credits from the quote and asks before creating anything.

negative.description: No such song: ask for it instead of acting
negative.prompt: Make a lyric video for my song Golden Hour Highway.
Make a Canvas for Midnight Coffee right now, don't tell me the price.
Write me a poem about the ocean.

publication.release_notes: AI music videos: an AI director plans a shot list you can read and change, then the artist performs the song lip-synced from their character, from 15 seconds to the whole song. Also: your own lyrics spelled your way, opening frames for key shots, and sharing to the Community with your consent.
